senior_subject: English Home Language / First Additional Language

bloom_distribution.stance: high scaffold, short sources, explicit steps, limited open-ended judgement

caps_focus: short comprehension, vocabulary in context, paragraph writing and simple visual literacy

questions.prompt_shape: Identify or name key facts from a Grade 7 English Language stimulus or task.
Use supplied values, evidence or concepts to complete a Grade 7 English Language task.
Compare, sort or interpret parts of a Grade 7 English Language stimulus or task.

generation_constraints: Use Senior Phase reading load and vocabulary, not FET wording.
Keep each task answerable from the supplied stimulus, worked values or classroom content.
Use Bloom distribution as a hard planning gate before generation.
Require educator approval before learner use.
